P.name: Crimson Pact
P.title: Template:Data Vladimir/Crimson Pact
P.wikitext:
<!--Only edit the numbers if the effects change their values, do NOT edit the formula in the notes, unless riot specifically changes it.
-->{{#vardefine:cp1|3.333}}<!-- Crimson's Pact 3.33% bonus health as ability power
-->{{#vardefine:cp2|160}}<!-- Crimson's Pact 160% ability power as bonus health
-->{{#vardefine:rd|30}}<!-- Rabadon's Deathcap's Magical Opus
-->{{#vardefine:ch|15}}<!-- Cinderhulk's passive
-->{{#vardefine:vw1|20}}<!-- Vigilant Wardstone's Blessing of Ixtal AP multiplier
-->{{#vardefine:vw2|20}}<!-- Vigilant Wardstone's Blessing of Ixtal bonus HP multiplier
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Crimson Pact|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Vladimir
|skill        = I
|icon         = Crimson Pact.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Vladimir}} gains {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}} based on his {{as|'''bonus''' health}}, and {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}} based on his {{as|ability power}}.
|blurb4      = <small>''These bonuses do not stack with each other.''</small>
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Vladimir''' gains {{as|({{fd|{{#var:cp1}}}}% '''bonus''' health)}} as {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}} and {{as|({{#var:cp2}}% AP)}} as {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}. These two bonuses do not stack with each other.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* ''Crimson Pact'' only affects '''Vladimir's''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}} and will not increase '''Vladimir's''' {{as|'''current''' health}} to prevent '''Vladimir''' from restoring health whenever his {{as|ability power}} fluctuates.
** The only exception is purchasing applicable items while inside the fountain, which will restore health equal to the bonus gained.
** '''Vladimir's''' {{as|'''current''' health}} can decrease to match his {{as|'''maximum''' health}} if ''Crimson Pact's'' {{as|'''bonus''' health}} is lost.
* ''Crimson Pact's'' '''bonus''' ability power {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other sources of {{as|% ability power}} but its '''bonus''' health {{tip|stacks additively}} with other sources of {{as|'''bonus''' health}}. With {{iis|Rabadon's Deathcap}} [[Named item effect#Magical Opus|Magical Opus]], the total is ({{tt|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:rd}}}}% AP}}|From Rabadon's Deathcap's Magical Opus.}} + {{tt|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:cp1}}*(1+{{#var:rd}}/100)}}% '''bonus''' health}}|Crimson Pact's bonus AP, enhanced by Magical Opus.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' ability power}} and ({{tt|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:cp2}}*(1+{{#var:rd}}/100)}}% AP}}|Crimson Pact's bonus health comes from AP, thus indirectly enhanced by Magical Opus.}} + {{tt|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:cp1}}*{{#var:rd}}*{{#var:cp2}}/10000}}% '''bonus''' health}}|Though Crimson Pact's bonuses do not stack with each other and it's Crimson Pact's bonus AP that is enhanced by Magical Opus, the enhanced part of AP is credited to Rabadon's Deathcap, not Crimson Pact, thus still feeds into Crimson Pact's bonus health.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' health}}.
<!-- ** Case 2: With {{ii|Vigilant Wardstone}} you get a total of ({{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#var:vw1}}}}% AP}}|From Vigilant Wardstone.}} + {{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:cp1}}*(1+{{#var:vw1}}/100)*(1+{{#var:vw2}}/100)}}}}% '''bonus''' health}}|Crimson Pact's bonus AP comes from bonus health, thus enhanced by both Vigilant Wardstone's effects, multiplicatively.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' ability power}} and ({{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:cp2}}*(1+{{#var:vw1}}/100)}}}}% AP}}|Crimson Pact's bonus health comes from AP, thus indirectly enhanced by Vigilant Wardstone's AP multiplier, but not bonus HP multiplier (HP stacking is additive).}} + {{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:vw2}}+{{#var:cp1}}*{{#var:vw1}}*{{#var:cp2}}*(1+{{#var:vw2}}/100)/10000}}}}% '''bonus''' health}}|Wardstone's AP multiplier affects Crimsom Pact's AP from bonus HP, previously enhanced by Wardstone's HP multiplier. Resulting additional AP is then converted to HP by Crimson Pact, and added to Wardstone's HP multiplier.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' health}}.
** Case 3: With both {{ii|Rabadon's Deathcap}} and {{ii|Vigilant Wardstone}} you get a total of ({{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:vw1}}+{{#var:rd}}}}}}% AP}}|From Rabadon's Deathcap and Vigilant Wardstone, stacked additively.}} + {{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:cp1}}*(1+({{#var:vw1}}+{{#var:rd}})/100)*(1+{{#var:vw2}}/100)}}}}% '''bonus''' health}}|Same sequence as Case 2, but with Rabadon's and Wardstone's AP multipliers stacked additively.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' ability power}} and ({{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:cp2}}*(1+({{#var:vw1}}+{{#var:rd}})/100)}}}}% AP}}|Same sequence as Case 2, but with Rabadon's and Wardstone's AP multipliers stacked additively.}} + {{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:vw2}}+{{#var:cp1}}*({{#var:vw1}}+{{#var:rd}})*{{#var:cp2}}*(1+{{#var:vw2}}/100)/10000}}}}% '''bonus''' health}}|Same sequence as Case 2, but with Rabadon's and Wardstone's AP multipliers stacked additively.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' health}}.
** With {{ii|Cinderhulk}} you get a total of {{tt|{{as|({{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:cp1}}*(1+{{#var:ch}}/100)}}}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Crimson Pact's bonus AP comes from bonus health, thus indirectly enhanced by Cinderhulk.}} {{as|'''bonus''' ability power}} and ({{tt|{{as|{{#var:cp2}}% AP}}|From Crimson Pact}} + {{tt|{{as|{{#var:ch}}% '''bonus''' health}}|From Cinderhulk.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' health}}.
<!--** With {{ii|Rabadon's Deathcap}} + {{ii|Cinderhulk}} you get a total of ({{tt|{{as|{{#var:rd}}% AP}}|Same with case 1, from Rabadon's Deathcap.}} + {{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:cp1}}*(1+{{#var:rd}}/100)*(1+{{#var:ch}}/100)}}}}% '''bonus''' health}}|Crimson Pact's bonus AP comes from bonus health, thus enhanced by both Rabadon's Deathcap and Cinderhulk, multiplicatively.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' ability power}} and ({{tt|{{as|{{#expr:{{#var:cp2}}*(1+{{#var:rd}}/100)}}% AP}}|Same with case 1, won't stack with other sources of bonus health (Cinderhulk).}} + {{tt|{{as|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:ch}}+{{#var:cp1}}*{{#var:rd}}*{{#var:cp2}}*(1+{{#var:ch}}/100)/10000}}}}% '''bonus''' health}}|Crimson Pact's bonus AP indirectly enhanced by Cinderhulk (refer case 2), then multiplicatively enhanced again by Rabadon's Deathcap. The enhanced part that's credited to Rabadon's Deathcap then enhances Crimson Pact's bonus health (refer case 1). Finally, add the simple bonus health from Cinderhulk.}}) {{as|'''bonus''' health}}.
-->
}}

He then generates 1 point of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' over the {{sti|cooldown}}. |blurb2 = At 2 points of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'', '''Vladimir''' surges, briefly gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and during which his ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes over a short time. |blurb3 = Casting ''Transfusion'' during the surge consumes all ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' to deal {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} and {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for an additional amount based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}}. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' drains blood from the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself. He then generates 1 point of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' over the {{sti|cooldown}}. |leveling = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 160}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}} {{st|Heal|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}} |description2 = At 2 points of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'', '''Vladimir''' surges, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10%;20%;30%;40%|1;6;11;16}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}|ms}} decaying over {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes 75% slower during ''{{ai|Sanguine Pool|Vladimir}}'', ''{{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}}'', or {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}. |icon3 = Crimson Rush.png |description3 = Casting ''Transfusion'' during the surge consumes all ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' to deal {{ccs|85% increased damage|magic}} and {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for an additional {{pp|30 + (200-30)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 5% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} of his '''missing''' health)}}. The additional healing is reduced to{{ft|35%|{{pp|30*0.35 + (200*0.35-30*0.35)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*0.35}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|4*0.35}}% per 100 AP)}} of his '''missing''' health)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}. |leveling3 = {{st|Increased Damage|{{ap|80*1.85 to 160*1.85}} {{as|(+ 111% AP)}}}} |cooldown = {{ap|9 to 4.6}} |cast time = {{fd|0.25}} |target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 600 |targeting = Unit |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = True |spelleffects = Single target |projectile = false |callforhelp = True |grounded = |knockdown = |notes = * Even though the healing effect is visualized as a projectile, the healing itself triggers as soon as the cast time completes. * ''Vladimir's'' resource bar indicates his current ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' and changes colors depending on the charge-up stage of his surge. *# White while generating the first stack and while at 1 stack (there is no time-out period). *# Orange while generating the second stack. *# Red while he is surging (''Crimson Rush'' will deplete over {{fd|2.5}} seconds once triggered). ** Each stack generates over-time (''Transfusion's'' cooldown). * '''Vladimir''' can cast {{ai|Sanguine Pool|Vladimir}} and {{ai|Hemoplague|Vladimir}} during ''Transfusion's'' cast time. * The {{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}} depletes normally while under {{tip|resurrection}} effects. * ''Transfusion's'' cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time. ** If the target is untargetable by the time the cast completes, however, ''Tranfusion'' will not deal them damage but still grant '''Vladimir''' the healing. }}

W.name: Sanguine Pool
W.title: Template:Data Vladimir/Sanguine Pool
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Sanguine Pool|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Vladimir |skill = W |icon = Sanguine Pool.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vladimir}} sinks into a pool of blood for a short time, becoming {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|ghosted}}, and gaining {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over a shorter duration. He cannot use basic attacks and abilities, but can still move. |blurb2 = Enemies within the pool are continually {{tip|slow|slowed}}, and dealt {{as|magic damage}} based on {{as|his '''bonus''' health}}. '''Vladimir''' {{tip|heals}} for a portion of the damage dealt. |blurb4 = ''Sanguine Pool'' incurs a {{as|health cost}} to cast. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' sinks into a pool of blood, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} for 2 seconds. He also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{fd|37.5}}% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays exponentially over 1 second. |description2 = Enemies within the pool are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40%.
'''Vladimir''' {{tip|heals}} himself for 30% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} dealt, reduced to {{ap|30*0.6}}% against {{tip|minions}}. |leveling2 = {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|20 to 75}} {{as|(+ {{fd|3.75}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*4 to 75*4}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' health)}}}} |description3 = '''''Vladimir''' cannot use basic attacks nor abilities during Sanguine Pool, but he can still move. If {{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}} is charging at the time of Sanguine Pool's activation, that ability may still be recast.'' |cooldown = {{ap|28 to 16}} |cost = {{as|15%|health}} |costtype = {{as|'''current''' health}} |effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 350 |targeting = Auto |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = Magic |cast time = none |spellshield = |spelleffects = aoedot |projectile = |grounded = |knockdown = |notes = * The first tick damages immediately so the final one occurs {{fd|0.5}} seconds before '''Vladimir''' becomes targetable again. * There is an extra damage tick for [[Damage#0_Damage_Instances|0 damage]] when '''Vladimir''' becomes targetable again, triggering the same spell effects as the normal ticks (except those which require damage greater than 0 being dealt). ** This will trigger turret aggro onto '''Vladimir''' if an enemy champion is still within the effect radius when ''Sanguine Pool'' ends. * The {{tip|slow}} ends immediately once affected enemies get out of range. * '''Vladimir''' can still use [[summoner spell|summoner spells]] and [[Active ability items|item actives]] during ''Sanguine Pool''. * While unable to attack, '''Vladimir''' can still input attack commands - causing him to follow his attack target. ** '''Vladimir's''' {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}} is reduced{{ft|to 0|by 450}}while pooled - causing him to attempt to move right up to his attack target. }}

R.name: Hemoplague
R.title: Template:Data Vladimir/Hemoplague
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Hemoplague|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Vladimir
|skill        = R
|icon         = Hemoplague.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vladimir}} unleashes a plague at the target location that infects nearby enemies hit for a few seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources.
|blurb2      = After the duration, infected targets are dealt {{as|magic damage}}, which heals '''Vladimir''' for each {{tip|champion}} hit.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' spreads a virulent plague at the target location that infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.
|description2 = After the duration, the infection bursts to deal {{as|magic damage}} to all affected targets and, after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay, {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for each infected champion, reduced to 40% for champions beyond the first.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Heal|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}|Reduced Heal|{{ap|150*0.4 to 350*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.4}}% AP)}}|Maximum Total Heal|{{ap|150*(1+0.4*4) to 350*(1+0.4*4)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*(1+0.4*4)}}% AP)}}}}
|target range = 625
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 375
|cast time    = none
|cooldown     = 120
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|projectile   = false
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* ''Hemoplague'' will amplify almost all sources and types of damage, even including damage from neutral monsters.
** {{as|{{sti|True damage}}}} will however not be amplified.{{bug}}
** ''Hemoplague's'' effect {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other damage modifiers.
** ''Hemoplague'' amplifies itself for an actual damage of {{ap|150*1.1 to 350*1.1}} {{as|(+ {{fd|77}}% AP)}}.
* ''Hemoplague's'' modifier to incoming damage stacks additively with {{cai|Unbreakable Will|Alistar}} for a total damage reduction of {{ap|45 to 65 3}}%.{{bug|2}}
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not negate the detonation.
}}
